site.tip1: Select 11 starters and keep one substitute per line: goalkeeper, defender, midfielder, forward.
site.tip2: Put players in their natural position; use C for the captain’s armband.
site.tip3: Publish when the lineup is final: players and the website see it, and it locks at kick-off.
site.f442: 4-4-2: balanced and easy to organise. Two strikers up front and two banks of four. A safe default for a mixed squad.
site.f433: 4-3-3: wingers stretch the pitch and one holding midfielder protects the back four. Needs pace out wide.
site.f4231: 4-2-3-1: two holding midfielders give security; one playmaker supports a lone striker. Good against high pressing.
site.f352: 3-5-2: wing-backs give the width with three centre-backs behind them. Needs fit wing-backs who run both ways.
site.f343: 3-4-3: very attacking, three forwards press together. Leaves space behind, so you need quick centre-backs.
site.f532: 5-3-2: compact defence and counter-attacks with two strikers. Good to protect a lead or face a stronger side.
site.f4141: 4-1-4-1: one holding midfielder shields the defence and wide midfielders tuck in. Solid and hard to break down.
site.f451: 4-5-1: crowded midfield to control the centre. The lone striker needs runners behind. Good away from home.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Afro Foot Club ry collects through its website (www.afrofoot.club) and its member app (app.afrofoot.club), why, who can see it, how long it is kept and what your rights are. It follows the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Finnish Data Protection Act.
privacyPolicy.controller: Afro Foot Club ry, a registered association in Helsinki, Finland, is the controller of your personal data.
privacyPolicy.data_lead: We only collect what we need to run the club. Depending on how you use our services:
privacyPolicy.data_items:
Account: email address, name, language, role (player, coach or administrator) and account status. Your password is stored only in hashed (unreadable) form. If you sign in with Google or Facebook, we receive your name, email address and an account identifier from them – never your password or your posts.
Player profile: date of birth, nationality, positions, shirt number and, if you add them, preferred foot, height, weight, a short bio and your photo.
Contact details: phone number, address and an emergency contact (name, relationship and phone).
Team activity: training attendance, your replies to events (in or out, and any note you write), match lineups, goals, assists, cards, minutes played and coaches' evaluations.
Membership and payments: membership plan, invoices, amounts, due dates, reference numbers and payment status. We do not collect card or bank account numbers; you pay by bank transfer from your own bank.
Agreements: your acceptance of the club's Code of Conduct and, for contracted players, the player contract and your electronic signature (typed name and time).
Applications and messages: tryout and membership applications (including your previous team, a link to your public Palloliitto profile and, for under-18s, a parent's or guardian's name and phone), and messages sent through the contact form.
Technical data: sign-in sessions and a log of changes made in the member app (who changed what and when), kept for security.
privacyPolicy.data_health: We do not ask for health information. If you write a reason for being absent (for example an injury), only your coaches and the club's administrators see it – please share no more than needed.
privacyPolicy.h_purposes: Why we use it, and on what legal basis
privacyPolicy.purposes_items:
Running your membership – teams, trainings, matches, communication and your member account: to perform the membership agreement (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
Fees, invoices and bookkeeping: to perform the agreement and to meet the Finnish Accounting Act (Art. 6(1)(b) and (c)).
Player contracts and the Code of Conduct: to perform the agreement, and the club's legitimate interest in fair and safe football (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f)).
Emergency contacts: to protect players' vital interests and the club's legitimate interest in safe activities (Art. 6(1)(d) and (f)).
Showing your name or photo publicly (website player list, public lineups, club media): only with your consent, which you can withdraw at any time (Art. 6(1)(a)).
Security and change logs: the club's legitimate interest in protecting members' data (Art. 6(1)(f)).
privacyPolicy.public_text: Match fixtures, results and team standings are public on our website. The squad on our website lists the club's players as registered with the Football Association of Finland (Palloliitto), whose player register is public: name, shirt number, position, and league goals and games – never birth year, nationality or licence. We do this in the club's legitimate interest in presenting its team. You can object at any time: remove yourself in the member app (My profile → On the club website) or write to us, and we take you off the list. Public lineups show your name only if you have agreed to it; otherwise "Player #" and your shirt number. To show the squad and statistics, the club keeps the list of its players registered with Palloliitto (name, shirt number, position, league statistics), visible in the member app only to club admins and coaches.
privacyPolicy.who_items:
You: your own profile, replies, statistics, invoices, agreements and contract.
Your coaches: the players of their own teams – contact and emergency details, attendance and replies, lineups, Code of Conduct status and player contracts (read-only).
Teammates: team schedules and, once published, the match lineup.
Club administrators: what is needed to run the club.
Service providers working for the club (below). We never sell your data or use it for advertising.
privacyPolicy.processors_items:
Supabase – database, sign-in, email for sign-in links, and file storage (photos).
Vercel – hosting of the website and the member app, and cookie-free visitor statistics of the website.
Twilio – text messages with sign-in codes, only if you sign in with your phone number.
Google and Meta (Facebook) – only if you choose to sign in with them.
The Football Association of Finland (Palloliitto) and its results service – official competition data.
privacyPolicy.processors_transfer: Some of these companies are based outside the EU/EEA. Where personal data is transferred outside the EU/EEA, this is done with the safeguards the GDPR requires, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.
privacyPolicy.retention_items:
Member and player data: while you are a member and up to 2 years after your membership ends; then deleted or anonymised.
Invoices and payment records: 6 years from the end of the financial year, as the Finnish Accounting Act requires.
Player contracts: for the contract period and 3 years after it ends.
Tryout and membership applications that do not lead to membership: 12 months.
Contact form messages: 2 years.
Match results and team statistics: kept as club history; on request we anonymise your name in them.
Change logs: 2 years.
privacyPolicy.rights_how: Send your request to <mail>{email}</mail>. We answer within one month. If you think we handle your data unlawfully, you can complain to the Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman in Finland (tietosuoja.fi).
privacyPolicy.delete_text: Email <mail>{email}</mail> from the address of your account and ask us to delete your account and data. We confirm your identity, delete or anonymise your data within 30 days and tell you what we must keep by law (for example invoices). If you used "Continue with Google" or "Continue with Facebook", you can also remove Afro Foot Club from the apps connected to your Google or Facebook account; this stops that way of signing in but does not delete what the club holds, so please send us the request as well.
privacyPolicy.children_text: Junior players can be members. For applicants under 18 we ask for a parent's or guardian's name and phone number. Children under 13 may use the member app only with a parent's or guardian's consent, and parents can exercise these rights on their child's behalf.
privacyPolicy.cookies_text: We only use cookies that the services need to work: one keeps you signed in to the member app and one remembers your language. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. To see which pages are visited, the website uses Vercel Web Analytics, which sets no cookies and does not identify you: it counts page views, the referring site, country and device type, without storing your IP address.
privacyPolicy.security_text: Access is limited by role: the database checks every request, so each member sees only what they need. Connections are encrypted (HTTPS), passwords are stored hashed, and changes in the member app are logged.
privacyPolicy.changes_text: We update this policy when our services change. The date at the top shows the current version; important changes are announced in the member app.
